---
title: "Troubleshooting"
description: "Help customers correct a selection, enable their camera, and finish capture."
---

Use capture guidance for adjustments while the camera is running. When capture fails, read `state.error.code` and offer a recovery action.

<AccordionGroup>
  <Accordion title="The wrong country or document was selected">
    Using `sdk` and `state` from the React quickstart, show a specific message and return the customer to the relevant selector:

    ```tsx
    const { ErrorCode } = sdk;
    
    const errorMessages = new Map([
      [ErrorCode.COUNTRY_MISMATCH, 'Choose the country that issued this document.'],
      [ErrorCode.DOCUMENT_TYPE_MISMATCH, 'Choose the type of document you are scanning.'],
      [ErrorCode.CAMERA_PERMISSION_DENIED, 'Allow camera access in your browser settings, then try again.'],
      [ErrorCode.CAMERA_UNAVAILABLE, 'Close other camera apps, then try again.'],
    ]);
    
    const message = (state.error && errorMessages.get(state.error.code))
      ?? 'Capture could not finish. Please try again.';
    
    return <p role="alert">{message}</p>;
    ```

    Before the first capture is accepted, reopen selection with `capture.current?.start(state.scanId, undefined, state.country)`. Let the customer confirm the corrected selection, then open the camera again. To use a different document after capture has already been accepted, begin a new scan through your backend.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="The camera will not open">
    Check that the page uses HTTPS or localhost, camera permission is enabled, and another application is not using the camera. Give the customer a retry button after they change the permission or close the other application.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="The document is in view but will not capture">
    Display the latest `Guidance` value as one instruction at a time:

    | Guidance | Suggested instruction |
    | --- | --- |
    | `ALIGN_DOCUMENT` | Place your document inside the guide |
    | `MOVE_CLOSER` | Move closer while keeping the document in focus |
    | `IMPROVE_FOCUS` | Hold the document steady |
    | `REDUCE_GLARE` | Tilt the document slightly to reduce glare |
    | `CLEAR_BACKGROUND` | Place your document on a plain background |
    | `HOLD_STILL` | Hold still; capturing automatically |
    | `FLIP_DOCUMENT` | Turn your document over |

    For small text or barcodes, suggest better lighting or show the [flashlight control](/external/customize#add-a-flashlight-button) when available.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Capture was interrupted">
    Use the existing scan ID to [resume capture](/external/resume). Accepted images remain attached to that scan. Display upload or processing progress while the SDK recovers.

    For `UNAUTHORIZED`, reload your authenticated onboarding data to obtain fresh token/configuration props and initialize the capture component again. For `ACCESS_DENIED`, end the attempt and show your application’s support path.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Capture moved to another window">
    For `Phase.SUPERSEDED`, tell the customer to continue in the other window. Avoid automatically restarting both windows.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="The scanner does not load">
    Confirm that `/bouncr/index.js` and the accompanying SDK assets are available from your deployed page. Check browser console and network errors for blocked scripts, workers, or missing files. If you use a Content Security Policy, permit the SDK’s scripts, workers, and API connection.

    When contacting support, include the SDK version, scan ID if available, browser/device version, error code, and the step that failed. Keep document images and credentials out of ordinary logs.
  </Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>
